articles.title: Refex Green Power wins 80 MW wind power project
articles.description: Refex Green Power, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Refex Renewables & Infrastructure, has won a tender and received a letter of award dated 04 September 2026, for setting-up of an 80-MW Wind Power Project, through bids invited by SJVN (A Joint Venture of Government of India and Government of Himachal Pradesh).

articles.title: No fund for school-hospital, Rs 4.69 crore for free work! High Court bans flyover tender
articles.description: Madhya Pradesh High Court has made strict remarks on the government and PWD regarding the maintenance of Habibganj flyover in Bhopal. The court raised the question as to why a new tender of ₹4.69 crore was issued when the contractor is ready to bear the expenses and carry out the repairs as per the contract. The court banned the tender and blacklisting of the contractor and directed to immediately remove the shortcomings.
